articles.title: Manasi Parekh recalls near-miss on yatra
articles.description: During a trip in Tibet, actor Manasi Parekh and her group faced natural calamity as floods hit nearby Nepal. Fortunately, their revised itinerary left them five hours away in a comfortable hotel equipped with food, electricity, and Wi-Fi. While they waited for news, Chinese officials and the Isha Foundation stepped in, facilitating an alternative exit plan. Now, the group is safely en route to their next destination.

A PhD student stumbled upon a lost Maya City while searching on Google; It was hidden under Mexican forest for 100 year
articles.description: A graduate student made an astounding discovery of the ancient Maya city of Valeriana through online environmental data. This hidden city boasts intricate pyramids and expansive plazas, along with countless structures veiled under dense forest. Utilising LiDAR technology, researchers unveiled vital urban and agricultural infrastructure elements, hinting at the potential for numerous other ancient sites within existing datasets waiting to be uncovered.

Emraan Hashmi became 'Batman' to get his cancer-stricken son to eat during chemotherapy, old video of actor resurfaces as he recalls the toughest days in hospital: "It's not easy for a child to undergo chemotherapy"
articles.description: Emraan Hashmi's son, Ayaan, faced an incredible fight against Wilms' tumour, a rare form of childhood kidney cancer. The path to recovery involved a tough regimen of surgery and chemotherapy. To uplift Ayaan's spirits, his father brought a sense of fun by dressing up as Batman, encouraging him to eat with playful imagination. Five years later, Ayaan triumphed over his battle, emerging cancer-free.

articles.title: Google’s India-first AI models for agriculture are finding applications beyond India
articles.description: Google's agricultural AI models, developed in India, have expanded their reach to eleven countries, facilitating advancements in farming and water management systems. By harnessing satellite imagery, these models support sustainable practices, such as rice cultivation and informed agricultural financing. State governments are now incorporating this innovative technology into their digital agriculture platforms, ultimately enhancing global food security through improved data access.

articles.title: How a 3-word phrase Travis Kelce said on his podcast unlocked a $100 million licensing deal
articles.description: Originating from the Kelce brothers' podcast, the term "92%ers" has sparked a phenomenon, transforming loyal listeners into a cultural movement. The momentum generated not only facilitated a major deal with Wondery, securing worldwide merchandise and advertising rights but also increased the podcast's appeal immensely. This comprehensive agreement, covering past content for profit, now allows Travis Kelce to earn even more than his football salary.

articles.title: From small roles to Masaan: Mukesh Chhabra recalls casting Vicky Kaushal
articles.description: Casting director Mukesh Chhabra disclosed that a last-minute alteration led to Vicky Kaushal landing the role in Masaan. A well-known actor unexpectedly left the project just a week before the casting process was set to close. After viewing Kaushal's audition tape, Chhabra and Anurag Kashyap made the daring choice to cast him. Initially met with skepticism regarding his fit for the lead, Kaushal's performance ultimately earned him significant praise.
